programme.title: Data collection, psychometric profiling and their impact on politics
programme.desc: Most political campaigns are data-driven nowadays, and many are getting into profiling of individual voters. Recently, a company with a strong background in military PSYOPS has implemented technology developed at Cambridge University, to enable psychological profiling based on digital traces. They have then been embedded into some of the most surprising recent political campaigns: Ted Cruz's, Donald Trump's and Leave.EU (Brexit). I will outline my personal journey, first discovering the technology as a test subject for Cambridge University, then investigating this company as a complete amateur, and eventually contributing to an article shared globally.A background article based on this research was published by NRK Beta early in february 2017, see .The speaker, Paul-Olivier Dehaye, is a mathematician at the University of Zurich working on interoperability tools enabling new forms of collaborative work on mathematical data, knowledge and software. In his spare time, he enjoys litigating (and especially winning!) against multibillion dollar businesses for the defence of his fundamental right to data protection. He is now leveraging that experience as co-founder of PersonalData.IO, a service that helps individuals regain control over their personal data.NUUG talk from 2017-04-04.

programme.sub-title: Tania Simoncelli: How I took on the gene patent industry -- and won
programme.desc: Are human genes patentable? Back in 2005, when Tania Simoncelli first contemplated this complex question, US patent law said they were — which meant patent holders had the right to stop anyone from sequencing, testing or even looking at a patented gene. Troubled by the way this law both harmed patients and created a barrier to biomedical innovation, Simoncelli and her colleagues at the ACLU challenged it. In this riveting talk, hear the story of how they took a case everybody told them they would lose all the way to the Supreme Court.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Practical Protocol-Oriented Programming in Swift
programme.desc: Value types are at the core of Swift (seriously, mostly everything in the Swift standard library is a value type). But how do you avoid subclassing? That's where the power of Protocol-Oriented programming comes in. Learn how to structure your code to (almost) never subclass again! Practical everyday examples and ideas for your own code base will be included.The speaker Natasha Murashev is an iOS developer by day and a robot by night. She blogs about Swift, WatchOS, and iOS development on her blog, natashatherobot.com, and curates a fast-growing weekly Swift newsletter: This Week in Swift. In her free time, she works on personal projects, speaks at meetups and conferences, contributes to open source, and likes to cross things off her bucket list. She's currently living the digital nomad life as her alter identity: @NatashaTheNomad.

programme.desc: Stellar astronomer and TED Senior Fellow Lucianne Walkowicz works on NASA's Kepler mission, searching for places in the universe that could support life. programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Linus Torvalds: The mind behind Linux
programme.desc: Linus Torvalds transformed technology twice — first with the Linux kernel, which helps power the Internet, and again with Git, the source code management system used by developers worldwide. In a rare interview with TED Curator Chris Anderson, Torvalds discusses with remarkable openness the personality traits that prompted his unique philosophy of work, engineering and life. "I am not a visionary, I'm an engineer," Torvalds says. "I'm perfectly happy with all the people who are walking around and just staring at the clouds ... but I'm looking at the ground, and I want to fix the pothole that's right in front of me before I fall in."TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.sub-title: Aomawa Shields: How we'll find life on other planets
programme.desc: Astronomer Aomawa Shields searches for clues that life might exist elsewhere in the universe by examining the atmospheres of distant exoplanets. When she isn't exploring the heavens, the classically trained actor (and TED Fellow) looks for ways to engage young women in the sciences using theater, writing and visual art. programme.title: Bygningsarven
programme.desc: Risør, også kjent som Den hvite by ved Skagerrak, har ett av de mest intakte bygningsmiljøene fra gammel tid. Her forenes bygningsarv med kystkultur, når byen arragerer Trebåtfestival.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.sub-title: Arkitekten som gjorde hjemmet til et eksperiment
programme.desc: Hvor langt kan du egentlig gå fra idé på tegnebrettet til ferdig bolig? En arkitekt har gjort sitt eget hjem til et levende laboratorium – og testet ut ideer i praksis.

programme.title: Herlige hjem
programme.desc: For et år siden flyttet småbarnsfamilien Erlandsen inn i ærverdige Villa Frednes, en herskapsvilla i Porsgrunn sentrum fra 1905 oppført i stilarten ny-renessanse. De fikk villaen på 1400 kvm for en billig penge mot at de pusset opp det staselige bygget. I den gamle vaktemesterboligen på Hovedøya i Oslo flyttet Anders og Rudolf inn for fem år siden, og ble de eneste fastboende på øya. Med klosterruinene vegg i vegg, har de skapt et idyllisk hjem som blander moderne design med herskapelig stil.

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: Med førstehåndsskildringer fra militære øyenvitner, insidere og UFO-eksperter ser man på hva en offentlig etterforskning av 144 observasjoner kan fortelle oss om de mystiske objektene og hvor de kom fra.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: Gjennom historien har gull blitt brukt i alt fra ornamenter til skapelsen av hellige gjenstander. Er det mulig at objekter av gull har en viss makt over oss? Kanskje noe vi ikke helt forstår?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Det finnes mange historier om sivilisasjoner som har blitt utryddet av vulkaner, jordskjelv, flom og meteorer. Er det mulig at utenomjordiske vesener var innblandet i oldtidens katastrofer?

programme.title: Eating History
programme.sub-title: From A Galaxy Far, Far Away
programme.desc: Josh og Old Smokey får en klissete utfordring da de skal smake på sjokoladekarameller fra Koreakrigen. Så får gutta prøve en klassisk middag fra grenselandet i nord i form av kokt elgkjøtt.

programme.title: Eating History
programme.desc: Gutta åpner en 40 år gammel boks med legendarisk "chips". Så drar de til Michigan for å treffe et par som har en av USAs største samlinger av klassiske merkevarer.

programme.desc: Politiet gjennomfører en spaningsoperasjon for å avsløre en mistenkt narkotikalanger som har solgt en dødelig dose fentanylpiller til en tenåring.

programme.title: Operation Undercover
programme.desc: En innsatsgruppe i en småby må hanskes med store narkotikaproblemer, deriblant en tidligere straffedømt som kan ha tilknytning til en stor leverandør.

programme.desc: Pasinetta blir funnet død i sitt hjem. Politiet graver i livet til den unge stjernen, og finner en lang rekke beundrere. Kan en forelskelse ha blitt dødelig?

programme.desc: Unge Kathey Horn forsvinner fra Traverse City om natten. Politiet jobber utrettelig for å finne henne, og avdekker en underverden full av nomadiske hippier og hekser.

programme.title: Australias ville fugler
programme.desc: Emuen er Australias største naturlige hjemmehørende fugl, og den nest største fuglen i verden etter slettestrutsen. Den er to meter høy, har et løpssteg på nesten tre meter og kan ikke fly. Den lever i en omvendt verden, der hunnene bestemmer, eggene er grønne og hannene har alt arbeidet med å lage og oppfostre bittesmå fugleunger kjent som "stripeys" på grunn av stripene.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Mekong er livslinjen til Kambodsja, spesielt i den knusktørre tørketiden, der fuktighet er vanskelig å finne. Lær hvordan alle slags flygende skapninger, fra fugler til flaggermus, håndterer ressursene frem til regntiden endelig kommer.

programme.title: Arabiske hav
programme.desc: Det er sommer i Omangolfen. Den stekende arabiske solen varmer opp det grunne vannet til 86 grader, noe som gir en oppblomstring av alger på et stort korallrev. Dette tiltrekker seg tusenvis av sultne planteetere, og skaper en områdekrig blant fiskene.

programme.title: Arabiske hav
programme.desc: Havskilpadden er et av de eldste dyrene i verden. Disse eldgamle havdyrene er til og med eldre enn dinosaurene. De har eksistert relativt uforandret i over 100 millioner år, men nå er alle de syv gjenværende artene utrydningstruet.

programme.title: Skyggelandet
programme.desc: Det sørvestlige hjørnet av New Zealands South Island er omringet av fjell og Stillehavet. Her leker sjeldne pingviner katt og mus med enorme sjøløver.

programme.title: Amerikas ville årstider
programme.desc: Sommeren fører med seg lange, varme dager som dyrelivet elsker. Se når dyrene lærer nye ferdigheter, konkurrerer om maker og unnslipper rovdyr mens de prøver å få mest mulig ut av den korte årstiden.

programme.title: Amerikas ville årstider
programme.desc: Når høsten brer seg over Amerika og trærne skifter farge, må dyrene ta livsviktige avgjørelser. Finn ut hvordan hvithodehavørner, bevere og andre dyr forbereder seg på de kalde, mørke og magre månedene som ligger foran dem.

programme.title: Merkelige skapninger
programme.desc: Hold avstand til disse naturlige morderne. Nakensnegler, blekkspruter, kjempeskolopendere og snikmorderinsekter er bevæpnet med gift og andre farlige verktøy som gjør det enklere å jakte (og er umulige å unnslippe).

programme.title: Amerikas ville årstider
programme.desc: Sommeren fører med seg lange, varme dager som dyrelivet elsker. Se når dyrene lærer nye ferdigheter, konkurrerer om maker og unnslipper rovdyr mens de prøver å få mest mulig ut av den korte årstiden.

programme.title: Beistets overlevelse
programme.desc: Finn veien gjennom en mangroveskog på Borneo med saltvannskrokodillen, som er perfekt tilpasset livet blant de våte røttene. Finn ut hvordan dette krypdyret bruker miljøet til å regulere kroppstemperaturen og hvorfor de er så gode jegere.

programme.title: Hunder med utrolige jobber
programme.desc: Møt en border collie som beskytter fly mot dødelige fuglekollisjoner, en sprocker spaniel som bruker luktesansen til å redde vannrotter i fare, og en anatolsk gjeterhund som bidrar til å bevare Afrikas mest utrydningstruede kattedyr, geparden.

programme.title: Hunder med utrolige jobber
programme.desc: Møt en golden retriever som demper angst og bidrar til å lege PTSD, en blandingshund som redder overlevende etter leirras, to spanieler som snuser seg fram til underjordiske vannlekkasjer, og en gruppe hunder i Storbritannia som hjelper barn med å lære å lese.

programme.title: Australias ville fugler
programme.desc: Australias rovfugler er noen av regionens tøffeste rovdyr. Disse svært spesialiserte drapsmaskinene er kraftige, ressurssterke og slående, og bruker imponerende våpen for å overleve. Dette er historien om luftens jegere i Australia.

programme.title: Beistets overlevelse
programme.desc: Undersøk kunsten å bygge rede med jungelens mesterbygger: orangutangen. Følg Max når han prøver å unnslippe den insektfylte skogbunnen i Borneos regnskog, og henter inspirason fra denne enslige primatens naturlige byggeferdigheter.

programme.title: Å bli en elefant: De foreldreløse fra Reteti
programme.desc: Besøk elefant-fristedet Reteti, som er drevet av lokalsamfunnet, der surrogatmødre tilbyr overlevelsestrening og omsorg for unge elefanter gjennom lek. Bli kjent med snabelløse Long’uro og se hvorfor 6-åringen Keleles sykdom kan forsinke friheten.

programme.title: Å bli en elefant: De foreldreløse fra Reteti
programme.desc: Det er en balanse mellom tøffe avskjeder og håp for fremtiden når en generasjon reddede elefanter slippes fri. Ønske de nye velkommen til Reteti-familien, inkludert en babyelefant som ble reddet fra et vannhull og en traumatisert sebra kalt Kisima.

programme.title: Australias ville fugler
programme.desc: Vellykket hekking er kritisk for å sikre at en fugleart overlever. I denne episoden møter vi fire fuglearter som gjør at de kan for å finne maker og oppfostre unger slik at neste generasjon for best mulig sjanse til å leve. Uansett hvor de holder til, står disse fuglene overfor store utfordringer med å beskytte territoriet sitt mot inntrengere, tiltrekke og vinne maker, og passe på ungene sine.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Mekong-deltaet er et av de største i verden. Det har blitt formet de siste 8000 årene, og sprer seg utover og renner ut i Sørkinahavet via ni kanaler. Disse kanalene deler og former kystlinjen, og skaper unike habitater for flere ulike dyr.

Uansett hvor de holder til, står disse fuglene overfor store utfordringer med å beskytte territoriet sitt mot inntrengere, tiltrekke og vinne maker, og passe på ungene sine.

programme.title: Mekongs mysterier
programme.desc: Mekong-deltaet er et av de største i verden. Det har blitt formet de siste 8000 årene, og sprer seg utover og renner ut i Sørkinahavet via ni kanaler. Disse kanalene deler og former kystlinjen, og skaper unike habitater for flere ulike dyr.

programme.title: Hunder med utrolige jobber
programme.desc: Møt en border collie som beskytter fly mot dødelige fuglekollisjoner, en sprocker spaniel som bruker luktesansen til å redde vannrotter i fare, og en anatolsk gjeterhund som bidrar til å bevare Afrikas mest utrydningstruede kattedyr, geparden.

programme.title: Hunder med utrolige jobber
programme.desc: Møt en golden retriever som demper angst og bidrar til å lege PTSD, en blandingshund som redder overlevende etter leirras, to spanieler som snuser seg fram til underjordiske vannlekkasjer, og en gruppe hunder i Storbritannia som hjelper barn med å lære å lese.

programme.title: Skyggelandet
programme.desc: Den sør-østre kysten av New Zealand har noen av verdens rikeste fiskebanker. Her lærer unge hvaler, delfiner og seler å jakte og å legge ut på egne eventyr.

programme.title: Å bli en elefant: De foreldreløse fra Reteti

programme.title: Steinway & Sons
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes at the Steinway & Sons factory and discover Spirio, the incredible technology that allows a piano to replay a performance exactly as it was played live. Mr. Guido Zimmermann, the president of the world-famous pianomakers, talks us through the revolutionary concept, accompanied by images of the precise, fascinating craftmanship and engineering that goes into each one of the Spirio pianos. Hugo Cohen Sprung's documentary also allows us insight into French pianist and Steinway artist Bertrand Chamayou's experience with the technology and features a preview of his unique two-piano concert in which he performs with his "shadow"!

programme.title: Wagner's Jews
programme.desc: Richard Wagner was notoriously anti-Semitic, and his writings on Jews were later embraced by Hitler and the Nazis. But for years, many of Wagner‘s closest associates were Jews - young musicians who became personally devoted to him, and provided crucial help to his work and career. Why were they drawn to him? And how could Wagner even accept their embrace? These questions are at the heart of ‘Wagner‘s Jews’, the first film to focus on Wagner‘s complex personal relationships with Jews. Filmed on location in Germany, Switzerland, and Italy, ‘Wagner‘s Jews’ reveals this remarkable story through archival sources, re-enactments, interviews, and performances of original musical works by Wagner‘s Jewish colleagues. Featuring Zubin Mehta and Leon Botstein among others, the film also explores the ongoing controversy over performing Wagner‘s music in Israel. The same questions asked in Wagner‘s time still resonate today: is it possible to separate the art from its creator? Can sublime music transcend prejudice and bigotry, and the weight of history?Subtitles available for this program with your remote controlSubtítulos disponibles para este programa con su control remoto.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: A cross between Taylorism and Bauhaus, the Van Nelle factory in Rotterdam, built between 1926 and 1931, is a gigantic factory where tobacco, coffee and tea were processed until the 1980s. The image is not that of a simple building, but that of a great machine, a great liner clad in glass and metal. Entirely glazed façades reveal the internal structure of the buildings, allowing workers to work in daylight. All movement is by sight through the glassed-in staircases and walkways - transparency is both a writing effect and a surveillance tool. Built by architects Jan Brickman and Leen Van der Vlugt, under the supervision of Van Nelle boss Kees Van der Leuw, the factory is the most important and accomplished achievement of the modern movement in industrial architecture.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Photo Contest

They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Caravaggio. You will discover his labour with Bacchus, Mary Magdalene or Christ at the Column.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Sandro Botticelli.You will discover his labour with Abundance or autumn, The story of virginia, Venus and Mars.

programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Caspar David Friedrich (1774-1840) est un peintre romantique allemand qui s’est surtout concentré sur l’art du paysage, qu’il traite avec une touche minutieuse. Il a été redécouvert à la fin du XIXe s. De caractère mélancolique, il a peuplé ses toiles de figures humaines de dos, contemplant l’immensité de la nature, comme son très célèbre Voyageur au-dessus de la mer de nuages de Hambourg ou ses Falaises de craie à Rügen. Observez ses superbes paysages aux tons crépusculaires.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: “Happiness is an angel with a serious face.” These words by the Italian painter Amadeo Modgliani define to perfection the portraits which made him famous… He reinvented the icon, with his oval faces, his elongated necks and lapis-lazuli eyes which are strangely expressive even when robbed of substance. You will be able to appreciate the simplicity of his figures, the restraint in his lines and colours, especially when you admire “The Woman with the Blue Eyes” or the “Portrait of Anna Zborowska”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Le palais des réceptions et des congrès de Rome
programme.desc: Adalberto Libera fut une des figures les plus importantes de l'architecture du XXème siècle, une des plus emblématiques aussi : il fut à la fois un pionnier de la modernité architecturale et un fasciste convaincu, architecte novateur et architecte du régime. Contrairement aux nazis, Mussolini fait alliance avec le mouvement moderne, qui devient, pour l'architecture, le style officiel du Fascisme. En 1937 le régime lance un de ses projets les plus ambitieux : l'E 42. Il s'agit de créer pour l'Exposition Internationale de 1942 une nouvelle ville monumentale incarnant la nouvelle Rome Impériale.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: David Hockney à la Royal Academy of Arts
programme.desc: David Hockney, généralement considéré comme l’un des artistes britanniques les plus populaires, connaît un succès mondial grâce à ses expositions à Londres, New York, Paris et ailleurs qui attirent des millions de spectateurs. Devenu récemment octogénaire, Hockney ne semble pas avoir l’intention de lever le pied ni de perdre son audace légendaire. Ce film révèle des interviews intimes et inédites et se concentre sur deux expositions à succès ayant eu lieu en 2012 et 2016 à la Royal Academy of Arts Londres. Le réalisateur Phil Grabsky a bénéficié d’un accès privilégié pour célébrer sur grand écran ce génie créatif du XXIe siècle.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Tout à la fois peintre et diplomate, Pierre-Paul Rubens (1577-1640) fut un personnage essentiel dans l’Europe artistique du XVIIe siècle. Il créa de vastes compositions pour les familles princières d’alors, comme le cycle sur la vie de Marie de Médicis, aujourd’hui conservé au musée du Louvre. Il incarne la veine baroque du Nord de l’Europe, développant un style tout en mouvement et aux touches colorées lumineuses, comme dans l’Enlèvement des filles de Leucippe exposé à Munich.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Rothko – Hartung: Colors and Cataclysms
programme.desc: Rothko and Hans Hartung forged a discreet, friendly and fertile bond. This documentary introduces the discovery of this little known and fascinating complicity between both artists.

programme.title: Warning ! Fresh paint
programme.desc: Since April 2018, the museum « La Piscine de Roubaix » prepare the extension of the exposition surface. In six months, thousand of works will be pick up, cleaned, restored and reinstalled.

programme.title: St+art India
programme.desc: In the heart of India, Bombay welcome the festival ST+ART, one of the most big urban arts festival in the country. Discover the backstage of the event and understand the relation between the habitants, artists and monumental murals.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the second exhibition of "Japanese Raw Art" at the Halle Saint Pierre. With this exhibition, we try to question and understand what makes the success and originality of raw art. Among the works on display you will be able to discover works by the iconic Japanese artist Sawada who participated in the Venice Biennale in 2013.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux amies de la scène et de la télévision, Ruth Madoc et Su Pollard, connues pour leurs apparitions dans la sitcom Hi-De-Hi, partent à la chasse aux antiquités avec Phil Serrell et Raj Bisram. Partis de Monmouth, ville frontalière du Pays de Galles, ils se rendent à Congleton, dans le Cheshire, pour une vente aux enchères.Ruth découvre également l'incroyable infirmière du XIXe siècle - et ce n'est pas Florence Nightingale - tandis que Su visite l'ancienne ville romaine de Caerleon et trouve le temps d'affronter Phil dans un amphithéâtre.Et Su tente de résoudre un vieux mystère... Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.sub-title: Yan Gongda - The Art of Calligraphy
programme.desc: While the hieroglyphs of Egypt and the cuneiform of Babylon have disappeared, Chinese calligraphy, also graphic and non-alphabetic, has endured through the ages. Of divinatory origin, Chinese characters carry not only a language but a unique way of thinking. A 84th-generation descendant of one of Confucius’s best-known disciples, calligrapher Yan Gongda unrolls before our camera the timeless story of a writing art closer to painting than graphology. Through this story, the entire history of China is told.

programme.title: Travelers
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, Travelers vous emmène à Copenhague au Danemark, dont le nom signifie « le port des marchands ». Tout d’abord nous irons aux jardins de Tivoli, le plus vieux parc d’attraction au monde. Puis nous nous rendrons dans le centre-ville où nous visiterons l’église Notre Sauveur, connue pour son clocher en spirale. Nous parlerons du design qui est presque une religion au Danemark, mais également de la gastronomie danoise, et bien d’autres choses.

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc: A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. This film offers a portrait full of contradictions.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En juin 2017, une grande exposition a ouvert à Paris au musée d’Orsay. Pour la première fois, cette exposition a réuni tous les portraits de Cézanne. Cela a été l’occasion d’analyser l’œuvre de Cézanne à l’aide d’experts internationaux et de parcourir les salles de la National Portrait Gallery de Londres et de la National Gallery of Art de Washington.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, (1525-1569) is one of the most renowned Flemish painters of the Renaissance. Although influenced by Italian art, his paintings maintained a typically Flemish tradition. A “peasant” painter, he depicted the lives of his country’s common folk as in the “Peasant Wedding”. In “Netherlandish Proverbs”, he wittily transcribes dozens of popular sayings. Admire also his incomplete “Tower of Babel”, a theme which Bruegel made into his own speciality.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: La maison Unal a été conçue par Claude Häusermann-Costy et construite par Joël Unal entre 1972 et 2008. Monsieur et Madame Unal rêvent, comme de nombreux Français, d’habiter une maison individuelle. C’est un programme classique, la maison de famille, qui aboutit à un résultat singulier – une maison bulle construite sans aucun angle droit. La maison Unal s’inscrit dans le courant architectural que l’on appelle "L’Architecture Sculpture". Pour tous les volumes de la maison, une seule technique de construction : le voile de béton sans coffrage, posé à la main sur une armature métallique.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Leonardo da Vinci.You will discover his labour with the Joconde, Salvator Mundi, The Cène.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherlands painter, Rembrandt.You will discover his labour with The night round, the return of the prodigal son, Danaé.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Francisco de Goya (1746-1828) est un peintre et graveur espagnol. Il introduit plusieurs ruptures stylistiques qui initièrent le romantisme et annoncèrent le début de la peinture contemporaine. Ses œuvres incluent des peintures de chevalet, des peintures murales, des gravures et des dessins. Nous allons découvrir des œuvres telles que “Self-portrait with glasses”, “The sleep of reason produces monsters” ou encore “The young ones”.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Leader of the School of Pont-Aven, Paul Gauguin, the most exotic of French artists, paved the way for modern painting. There were two main themes which marked his work: Brittany and Tahiti. A rebel, he rejected copying reality in favour of exploring more delicate painting techniques. You will discover here the most important milestones in his work: from “Four Breton Girls” to “Tahitian Women on the Beach”, by way of the surprising “Self Portrait with Yellow Christ”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In 1050, one of the first major pilgrimage churches in the Western world was built at Conques, in the middle of the wild Aveyron landscape. This was the birth of "Romanesque" architecture. The abbey church - i.e., a church belonging to an abbey - at Conques is one of the most important structures built in 11th-century France. Its coherence, its location - a small village in the Rouergue region, far from the main medieval traffic routes - its innovative aspect, its state of preservation and the fact that the relics for which it was built are still in situ, make the church at Conques the best work of art for approaching Romanesque architecture in France. In other words, to try and understand how architecture was made at that time in our history, and to dismantle not only the building itself, but also a number of preconceived ideas about Romanesque art, starting with its very name, which is an intellectual construct of the 19th century, or to put it another way: those who built Conques.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Le musée d’Orsay, qui fut d'abord une gare construite pour l'Exposition universelle de 1900, abrite la production artistique du monde occidental sur la période de 1848 à 1914. De nombreux courants artistiques y sont présentés : académisme, réalisme, symbolisme, Art nouveau, et bien sur l’impressionnisme avec des œuvres et des artistes incontournables tels que l’Olympia de Manet, le Bal du moulin de la galette de Renoir, l’Etoile de Degas ou le Cirque de Seurat.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En juin 2017, une grande exposition a ouvert à Paris au musée d’Orsay. Pour la première fois, cette exposition a réuni tous les portraits de Cézanne. Cela a été l’occasion d’analyser l’œuvre de Cézanne à l’aide d’experts internationaux et de parcourir les salles de la National Portrait Gallery de Londres et de la National Gallery of Art de Washington.

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc: A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. This film offers a portrait full of contradictions.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Jean-Jacques Lequeu - Builder of fantasies" at the Petit Palais. This exhibition is dedicated to the work of the late 18th century architect Jean-Jacques Lequeu. Despite his profession, he was not known for his constructions, but for his drawings. He made many portraits or drawings of everyday objects, architectural diagrams.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Gutenberg est considéré comme le père de l’imprimerie moderne. La petite histoire raconte qu’il se serait inspiré du pressoir à raisin utilisé par les vignerons pour inventer sa machine. De cette anecdote historique, deux artistes ont entrepris d’éditer un livre qui étanchera la soif de n’importe quel lecteur gourmand. Dans cet épisode, nous rencontrerons Luz et Anaïs, deux artistes opposées et absolument complémentaires.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Always self-confident, this 40-year-old father is an unrivalled handyman. However, for this resident of Barvaux, decorating hasn't always been his first passion. Today, our decorating enthusiast has found his own style. He prefers raw materials and natural elements. This week’s theme suits him like a glove. Geoffrey has every intention of winning this week's competition and becoming the ace decorator. And to win, he's going to have to convince Laetitia.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui c'est sur la route des champignons que Julie nous embarque. Rien de mieux pour occuper ses week-ends qu’une balade en forêt à la recherche de champignons comestibles. Certaines espèces, comme le cèpe ou la girolle, se conservent très bien au congélateur ou, pour les plus patients, en bocaux. Nous aurons également l'occasion de rencontrer deux Chefs passionnés par les champignons, devenus des spécialistes du sujet : Franck Quinton et Régis Marcon. Mais pour l’instant on prend la route, à la découverte de plats typiquement français avec d’étonnants champignons de Paris en Touraine, des morilles dans le Jura, des cèpes en Gironde, des russules charbonnières en Normandie et des coulemelles en Auvergne !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo invite son amie Eleonora Galasso pour une pizza party ! Elles vont d'abord préparer une pâte maison. Ensuite, elles cuisineront une capriciosa avec des anchois, des câpres et du jambon, ainsi qu'une pizza fritta avec de l’origan et de la sauce tomate.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine des pois chiches. Comme ils sont originaires du Moyen-Orient, elle décide de préparer des recettes libanaises. Au menu : fallafels avec des pois chiches, du kumquat, des épices, de la cannelle, et blettes aux pois chiches, persil, menthe et boulgour.

programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 2
programme.desc: On se retrouve en Israël dans le désert du Neguev, Elaine cherche des solutions pour lutter contre la désertification. L’objet de ses recherches : les arbres, peu consommateurs d’eau. Au Mali, on retrouve les Dogons : les cultivateurs du désert. Il nous fait découvrir les recettes de son peuple pour gérer l’eau. Dans cette partie du Mali où il ne pleut quasiment jamais. En Palestine, le village de Wadi Fukeen. Un village où les agriculteurs utilisent un système d’irrigation et de partage de l’eau vieux de plus de 300 ans et basé sur le respect et la confiance. Et en Palestine à Gaza où les spécialistes se battent pour sauver des enfants palestiniens rendus malades par de l’eau impropre à la consommation. programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand thus continues his world tour and his inventory of the planet with the great rivers that suffer from man's excesses as a common thread. " So the great rivers may live" is the discovery of places, men and women who are fighting so that our waterways simply have their place on Earth. Thanks to his genius, man is correcting his mistakes: the Aral Sea, which once disappeared, is coming back. In New York, millions of people have drinking water thanks to the natural virtues of the forest.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Bangladesh - Partie 2
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York, has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

Together, they will prepare recipes that are both tasty and perfectly balanced: corn pizza with vegetables and peach-cassis and verbena puffs...

programme.desc: The prestige buffet is the biggest event of the competition's grand finale. This year, it comes with a twist. Guillaume Gomez, head chef at the Elysée Palace, wanted to entrust the finalists with the task of creating the buffets for the Pastry Day organized by the French presidential palace in honor of the profession. Assisted by two clerks, the young talents have five hours to rise to the challenge and honor the greatest names in French patisserie who are present for the occasion. Then it will be revealed who will succeed Audrey and Ophélie, winners of the two previous editions of this mouth-watering competition. Their recipes have been published in two beautiful books.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In Sardinia, Mediterranean food, social bonds, and an active lifestyle explain the exceptional longevity of its people. Health is linked to simplicity, daily joy, and community strength.

programme.desc: Sardinian culinary traditions rely on local foods, generational practices, and sharing. Dr. Ivo Pirisi shows how these habits promote long, healthy lives through cooperation and quality ingredients.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In La Paz, over 3,600 meters above sea level, we explore the effects of altitude on the human body. Ancestral remedies like coca leaves help relieve symptoms. This traditional medicine illustrates human resilience and the richness of local knowledge.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Andean cultures produce foods adapted to high altitudes, such as royal quinoa. With a Bolivian chef, we prepare dishes that celebrate nutrition, culture, and community. In Bolivia, eating is a celebration of the land and its gifts.

programme.desc: At Lake Titicaca, we attend a Pachamama ceremony to honor the Earth. This stunning site faces threats from pollution and invasive species. This episode reminds us of our interdependence with nature and the urgent need to protect it.

programme.sub-title: Fais ton Sport à la Maison
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode de Fais ton Sport à la Maison, Sabrina et Guigui vous proposent une séance full body à la fois efficace et accessible. On commence avec un échauffement articulé de la tête aux pieds : chevilles, genoux, hanches, colonne, épaules, nuque… rien n’est oublié. Les mouvements sont progressifs, le ton est léger, et l’ambiance reste motivante du début à la fin. Sabrina se concentre sur le bas du corps pendant que Guigui cible le haut, pour un training vraiment complet. Une séance idéale pour renforcer l’ensemble du corps sans stress et avec le sourire !

programme.desc: Detoxify your whole body with this spine-loving sequence. Learn to be softer on the outside, as you awaken the power of your core. Align Your Axis provides an opportunity to wring out any unwanted emotions, and let go of any thoughts or ideas that cloud your perspective.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: It's the long-awaited day of the grand final. But before seeing the reaction of the owners and finding out their scores, each candidate will find out what the other contestants thought of their choice in terms of decoration. And it's Armand who will be the first to join our decorating expert, Valérie Damidot, in the workshop. Armand is about to discover the criticisms of his opponents. We hope for his sake that his heart is in the right place.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Direction le Loir-et-Cher pour une chasse à courre encadrée par les équipes de l’ONCFS. Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo puts Normandy in the spotlight! With the region's president, Hervé Morin, she prepares apples poached in cinnamon syrup, as well as mussels... in her own way.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Avec son amie Myriam, Luana Belmondo prépare deux recettes à base de safran. Au programme : orecchiette (petites pâtes italiennes) avec de la saucisse, et lotte au citron confit avec sa purée d’asperges.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 1
programme.desc: The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface. The sea is the largest natural environment on our planet and remains virtually unexploited. In Brittany, in the Seven Islands. Then in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc, in the middle of a sea of green algae. In Brittany, intensive agriculture has developed over the last thirty years. In New Caledonia, the coral reef is the second largest in the world and could be threatened by the construction of a nickel mine. In Normandy, in the Botanical Garden of Vauville, an extraordinary garden has plants from all over the world. Also in the Archipelago of Chausey in Normandy with the highest tides in Europe. Or the Mont Saint Michel. As a result of silting up and man-made works, the Mont was no longer an island. In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 prot.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Bangladesh - Partie 2
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York, has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 1
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Leftovers often end up in the garbage can. But with a little thought, it's easy to recycle them. This ecological and economical gesture can even delight our taste buds. Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan panacakes.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in the name of sustainable development and environmental protection. He shows us the incredible wealth of our planet and goes to meet those who propose solutions to perpetuate farming and cultivation models. We discover how to feed ourselves without destroying in the Rhône-Alpes region, how to preserve the forest in Indonesia, but also the extent of GMOs in Alsace as well as the advantages of terroir in Provence-Alpes-Côte-D'azur.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 1
programme.desc: Animals represent 2/3 of the species on earth. We are increasingly concerned about our impact on the world. But what place does man have for the wild animal? Discover how it is possible to reintroduce wild animals in South Africa, or the disaster that took place with the sea lions in Namibia, and also how to preserve rhinos or other animals in biodiversity. There, women and men manage to protect wildlife every day.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 2
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand surprises us with preserved landscapes. And sometimes even with vast spaces where man's imprint remains invisible. Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in favour of the protection of the environment and wildlife. From the tip of the African continent, he decides to take down the fences to let the animals roam freely, then he takes us to Cambodia to see if the tigers will disappear. Then we head to London to follow the chimpanzee or to France to study and save the bees.

programme.desc: Massage studio will show you the best massage techniques in places which will make you dream. Let us take care of you! Lay down, relax and forget all your problems.

programme.desc: Turn down the lights, kick your shoes back, take a cup of tea... You're on MyZen TV, time to relax.

programme.desc: Watch beautiful landscapes from all over the world !

programme.title: Nature's Nurseries - The Next Wild Generation
programme.desc: Over hele verden står alle arter overfor den samme utfordringen: å gi neste generasjon en best mulig start.

programme.title: Kannibalhai
programme.desc: Verdens fremste haiforskere leder en gransking av den fascinerende verdenen til kannibalhaier. Fra den 50 cm lange sigarhaien som river ut biter av hvithaien som er ti ganger så stor, til sandtigerhai-unger som angriper og spiser hverandre inne i mors mage. Stålsett deg til å se haier som du aldri har sett dem før.

programme.title: Perfect Predator
programme.desc: Haiene har utviklet seg til å bli det perfekte rovdyr, med sin store størrelse og finjusterte jaktferdigheter. Vi følger et team av forskere når de prøver å avdekke mysteriene bak disse ikoniske dyrene, inkludert hvordan deres underlige oppførsel – som kannibalisme – er designet for å holde disse tøffe rovdyrene på toppen av næringskjeden.

programme.title: Afrikas elvegiganter
programme.desc: Afrikas kraftfulle elver huser et variert utvalg av beboere slik som elefanter og flodhester som spiser og drikker der krokodillene jakter og formerer seg. Vi avslører hvordan disse gigantiske dyrene ufrivillig deler vannet med andre, mindre skapninger slik som pinnsvin, kampørner og leoparder.

programme.title: Jaguar: Jungle Icon of Guyana
programme.desc: En ung jaguar skal til å dra ut på sitt aller viktigste oppdrag i livet: å finne sitt eget kongerike. Reisen tar ham gjennom varierte habitater, som alle har sitt eget utvalg av dyr. Det er kun om han kan bevise sin verdi at han kan ta tronen i et av de aller siste ville paradisene i verden.

programme.desc: Når man har alt, hvorfor skulle man gi slipp på det? En forventer at dyr velger den enkleste og sikreste måten for å sikre seg mat, trygghet og ly.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa the Wild Side Updates
programme.desc: Dyrefamilier er ville, vidunderlige og akkurat som oss! I Zoo Tampa ønsker det hvite neshornet en ny okse for parring og en livlig baby velkommen. En søt, nyfødt tapir erobrer bassenget på klumsete vis og en 1 måned gammel dvergflodhest svømmer med moren. Dyrepasserne ser til alle dyrefamiliene, fra afrikanske pingvinbabyer til inkaterneunger.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: Vi reiser fra sør til nord og utforsker de fjerneste avkrokene til Appalachian Trail og møter forskerne som jobber for å bevare området.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: Vi følger med JT Reynolds, Death Valleys store forkjemper, for å møte forskerne som jobber for å bevare det unike stedet.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa
programme.sub-title: Dyrehagens hemmeligheter: Tampa - en stjerne er født
programme.desc: ZooTampa har noen fantastiske dyr fra hele verden. Dyrene er vant til å få oppmerksomhet fra begeistrede gjester, men overraskende nok får de mest oppmerksomhet fra staben. Man blir bekymret da man finner en mystisk kul på en av ponniene. Mårbjørnene Sully og Melati flytter inn i sitt nye hjem. Teamet følger nøye med og håper at de oppstår varme følelser, men Melati lar seg ikke sjarmere så lett. Dyrehagen må ta farvel med sebraen Rafiki, men først steller de hovene hans. Hos pingvinene skal eggene klekkes, og dyrepasserne gleder seg til å ta imot en ny stjerne.

programme.desc: Simon og Sioux prøver å fjerne en 2,5 meter lang svart mamba som holder et helt leilighetsbygg fanget. Så drar Sioux ut alene for å redde en annen slange i et bryllupslokale. I Sør-Afrika havner lærlingen Mbali i livsfare da hun setter fri en svart mamba for første gang.

programme.desc: I India må Simon og Sioux hanskes med en slange som er fanget i en vanntank, en diger rottesnok på en motorsykkel og en livsfarlig kobra som truer arbeiderne på et lager. I Sør-Afrika fullfører Mbali opplæringen ved å fange en diger svart mamba i en hagebod.

programme.title: Slangebyen
programme.desc: Under monsunsesongen i Mysore er det slanger overalt, der enorme pytonslanger, dødelige Russells huggormer og rottesnoker har inntatt byen. Simon og Sioux lærer mye underveis av den lokale slangejegeren "Snake" Shyam. De må redde slanger fra butikker, gårder, byggeplasser og mye mer.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: Spenn deg fast for et spennende eventyr på Afrikas sletter – i Zoo Tampa-stil! I denne actionfylte episoden har afrikanske dyr hovedrollen. Dyreparken får sin første hunngiraff, elefanters intelligens og samarbeidsvilje testes, og en ny neshornbaby blir født.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa
programme.sub-title: Rhinos, Koalas and Bears... Oh My!
programme.desc: Forelsk deg i asiatiske og australske dyr i Zoo Tampa! I denne spesialepisoden har en malayabjørn time hos tannlegen, et par treleoparder utforsker sitt nye habitat, dyreparken tar farvel med en elsket koala og et neshornpar blir forelsket.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Med fødslene av grisunger og geitekillinger utfører veterinærene nærmest mirakler. Så må dr. Brenda og dr. Lisa behandle flere fotskader, blant annet en sheltie som har flere brudd i tærne. Dr. Pol undersøker en diger mastiff med mageproblemer og en skadet kanin. Pol-familien tar til seg en drektig hest, og dr. Nicole får hendene fulle med en hane og en katt.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Fra merkelig til sjokkerende, Pol Vets ser alt! En katts skadede øye skjuler en overraskelse, en snodig and har problemer med å legge egg, et fredelig esel har en vond hov og en høyt verdsatt geit brekker beinet. Dr. Pol begynner dagen med en helsesjekk for 26 valper, dr. Lisa løser et problem med en manglende hale og dr. Nicole går på markjakt.

programme.title: Song of the Rainforest
programme.desc: Hainan tropiske regnskog nasjonalpark ble opprettet i 2021 og er en av Kinas fem første nasjonalparker. Her finner man et enestående biologisk mangfold, fra frodig tropisk regnskog i lavlandet til tåkeskoger som dekker fjelltopper 1800 meter over havet. Blant de mange sjeldne artene finner vi Hainan-gibbonen og orkideer som ikke finnes noe annet sted i verden. Høyt til fjells ligger et mosedekt landskap innhyllet i tåke. Nasjonalparken er avgjørende for vannforsyningen på hele øya og dermed for alt liv her. De høye fjellene fanger opp fuktighet som fyller øyas viktigste elver med vann. Tåke og regn sørger samtidig for livgivende vann til skogene og det rike plante- og dyrelivet. Alt liv her følger regnskogens rytme. Over tid har artene utviklet sine egne finurlige måter å leve side om side på og finne sin plass i dette frodige økosystemet.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Alpebukker springer ned fra de bratte klippene, himmelen fylles av millioner av fugler under det imponerende trekket, og midt på vinteren leter den sjeldne gaupa etter en make.

programme.desc: I India må Simon og Sioux hanskes med en slange som er fanget i en vanntank, en diger rottesnok på en motorsykkel og en livsfarlig kobra som truer arbeiderne på et lager. I Sør-Afrika fullfører Mbali opplæringen ved å fange en diger svart mamba i en hagebod.

programme.title: Slangebyen
programme.desc: Under monsunsesongen i Mysore er det slanger overalt, der enorme pytonslanger, dødelige Russells huggormer og rottesnoker har inntatt byen. Simon og Sioux lærer mye underveis av den lokale slangejegeren "Snake" Shyam. De må redde slanger fra butikker, gårder, byggeplasser og mye mer.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Flere hundre kilometer utenfor kysten av Ecuador finnes det en gruppe vulkanøyer som huser noen av de merkeligste livsformene som finnes. programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: Canyonlands er en ukjent perle blant USAs nasjonalparker. Det ulendte terrenget er ikke bare vakkert, men også en historiebok.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: National Geographic blir med på en spennende reise over 445 kilometer for å utforske Grand Canyon og dens mysterier.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Ekvator strekker seg 4000 kilometer over det afrikanske kontinentet. Artene som finnes her, er like mangfoldige som landskapet. Enorme planteetere og legendariske rovdyr dominerer de karrige gresslettene, mens de sjeldne apekattene trives i regnskogene. Hvert år etterfølges flommen av sult, men dyrene har tilpasset seg til omgivelsene. Dette er Ekvatorial-Afrika, evolusjonens hjerte.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Korallrevene i Asia-Stillehavsregionen er de mest mangfoldige i hele verden. Og de fantastiske skapningene i havets regnskog er avhengige av hverandre for å overleve.
